title: Observability integrity: the event layer must not silently lose events
subject: observability-event-integrity
ratio: The observability layer must not silently lose events. Every refusal, contention and boundary crossing logs a structured event; timestamps compare at equal precision; logged paths are normalized repo-relative. A control-plane change that lets an event vanish silently, a comparison mix precision, or an absolute path reach the logs is a defect to fix before it ships.
dicta: The generalizable rule, not the bug stories: the CD5 consolidated-record option exercised, member fixes named in tier_evidence as the ledger requires. P-005 (TTL-floor comparison: floor both sides so truncation cancels), P-006 (lock-busy refusals log a structured event), P-008 (path normalization at the log boundary); applied at T-013 and T-014, verdicted by harness-verifier. No standing prose home exists for the generalized rule, stated honestly per CD6: it lives as enforced code behavior plus the audit_gen2.md diagnosis, its primary home, carried as a path: validity entry. Cites the hook-fed-logging record published earlier in this wave: channel and integrity are siblings. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-17.
